name: FV_DATA_ACT_DEF_USSGL_ACCTS
description: This table stores information about USSGL accounts and the criteria to process the accounts.

columns.name: DATA_ACT_DEF_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Amount Definition Header.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DEFINITION_USSGL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the USSGL account for the amount definition.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: USSGL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: USSGL account associated with the amount definition.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The balance type code that determines the account balance to be retrieved for the USSGL account.
